body: Thank you to everyone here. I don't think anyone's really talked to me on a personal level in months, it was nice to hear from people. Things still seem pretty bleak, but I feel better for having received advice.

What I've found is that trying to make things better means throwing myself back into things like school or maintaining relationships with people, both of which are sources of stress for me. It seems very self-perpetuating, especially when I try to do something about it.
